prompt:
The order lookup endpoint has an N+1 query problem hidden in its service-layer
enrichment loop. Replace per-order/customer/product Find calls in Lookup.Run
with the already-supported repository FindMany APIs, preserving complete
observable output and the single-record Inspector API.

Follow README's exact batching and error contract: zero calls for empty input;
one order batch of stable unique IDs otherwise; at most one stable unique
customer batch and one SKU batch for found requested orders. Preserve duplicate
request entries, missing entries, order/line order, opaque empty-string keys,
missing related-row semantics, nil-on-error behavior, and non-null empty result
and line arrays. Ignore extra unrequested batch rows and do not mutate inputs
or repository data. No cross-request caching or wall-time shortcuts. Update
docs/performance.md to explain the bounded call plan. Exercise correctness
using operation counters rather than elapsed time.

Visible tests: `go test ./...`.
